regions.today: A cloudy start today with just isolated showers. Some sunny spells will develop through the morning but it will turn cloudier through the afternoon with some patches of drizzle developing later in the evening. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees in light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Cloudy at first tonight with scattered outbreaks of rain and drizzle. The rain will clear eastwards overnight with clear spells and isolated showers following. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees in light to moderate southwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: A dry start tomorrow but widespread showers will develop through the afternoon, some of which will be heavy with the chance of isolated thunderstorms. Showers will become more isolated in the evening. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees in moderate, occasionally fresh, west to southwest winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate on Tuesday, high in any sunshine. Moderate on Wednesday.
